en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id al-Thaqafi narrated to us. Yaqub, meaning Ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qari, narrated to us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd. Qutaybah also narrated it to us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim narrated to us, from his father, from Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Saidi. He said: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, I have come to offer myself to you. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) looked at her, looking up and down, then lowered his head. When the woman saw that he had made no decision about her, she sat down. A man from his companions stood and said: Messenger of Allah, if you have no need of her, marry her to me. He said: Do you have anything? He said: No, by Allah, Messenger of Allah. He said: Go to your family and see whether you can find something. He went and returned, saying: No, by Allah, I found nothing. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Look, even for an iron ring. He went and returned, saying: No, by Allah, not even an iron ring. But this is my waist-wrapper, he said; Sahl said he had no cloak. She may have half of it. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: What would you do with your waist-wrapper? If you wore it, she would have none of it, and if she wore it, you would have none of it. The man sat until his sitting became long, then stood and left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw him turning away, ordered that he be called, and when he came said: What do you have of the Quran? He said: I have such and such chapters, and he named them. He said: Can you recite them from memory? He said: Yes. He said: Go, for I have married her to you because of what you have of the Quran. This is the hadith of Ibn Abi Hazim; the hadith of Yaqub is close to it in wording.

en: Khalaf ibn Hisham narrated it to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us. Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from al-Darawardi. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Husayn ibn Ali narrated to us, from Za'idah. All of them narrated from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd, with this hadith, each adding to the others. In Za'idah's narration it says: Go, for I have married her to you, so teach her some of the Quran.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad narrated to us. Yazid ibn Abd Allah ibn Usamah ibn al-Had narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Abi Umar al-Makki narrated to me, and his is the wording. Abd al-Aziz narrated to us, from Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman. He said: I asked Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), how much the dowry of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was. She said: His dowry for his wives was twelve awqiyah and a nash. She said: Do you know what a nash is? I said: No. She said: Half an awqiyah. That makes five hundred dirhams. This was the dowry of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) for his wives.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim berichtete uns. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. Yazid ibn Abd Allah ibn Usamah ibn al-Had überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Abi Umar al-Makki überlieferte mir, and his is the wording. Abd al-Aziz überlieferte uns, from Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman. Er sagte: I asked Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), how much the Brautgabe of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was. She said: His Brautgabe for his wives was twelve awqiyah and a nash. She said: Do you know what a nash is? I said: No. She said: Half an awqiyah. That makes five hundred dirhams. This was the Brautgabe of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) for his wives. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu al-Rabi Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Ataki, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, and the wording is Yahya's. Yahya said: He informed us, and the other two said: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik. The Prophet (peace be upon him) saw a trace of saffron on Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf and said: What is this? He said: Messenger of Allah, I married a woman for a gold nugget's weight of gold. He said: May Allah bless you. Hold a wedding feast, even if only with one sheep.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu al-Rabi Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Ataki, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, and the wording is Yahya's. en: Muhammad ibn Ubayd al-Ghubari narrated to us. Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik. Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf married during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) for a gold nugget's weight of gold. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to him: Hold a wedding feast, even if only with one sheep.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us. Waki narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Qatadah and Humayd, from Anas. Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf married a woman for a gold nugget's weight of gold, and the Prophet (peace be upon him) said to him: Hold a wedding feast, even if only with one sheep.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us. Abu Dawud narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Rafi and Harun ibn Abd Allah narrated to us. They both said: Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us. Ahmad ibn Khirash narrated to us. Shababah narrated to us. All of them narrated from Shubah, from Humayd, with this chain, except that in Wahb's narration Abd al-Rahman said: I married a woman.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Qudamah informed us. al-Nadr ibn Shumayl narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb narrated to us. He said: I heard Anas say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw me with the joy of a wedding. I said: I married a woman from the Ansar. He said: How much did you give her as dowry? I said: A gold nugget. Ishaq's narration says: a gold nugget's weight.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Qudamah berichtete uns. al-Nadr ibn Shumayl überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Anas say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw me with the joy of a Hochzeit. I said: I heiratete a woman from the Ansar. Er sagte: How much did you give her as Brautgabe? I said: A gold nugget. Ishaq's narration says: a gold nugget's weight. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abu Dawud narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Abu Hamzah, whom Shubah said was Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abd Allah, from Anas ibn Malik. Abd al-Rahman married a woman for a gold nugget's weight of gold.
de: Ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abu Dawud überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Abu Hamzah, whom Shubah said was Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abd Allah, from Anas ibn Malik. en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to me. Wahb narrated to us. Shubah informed us with this chain, except that he said: A man from the descendants of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: Of gold.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to me. Wahb überlieferte uns. Shubah berichtete uns with this chain, except that he said: A man from the descendants of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: Of gold. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Anas said: I attended Zaynab's wedding feast. He satisfied the people with bread and meat, and he used to send me to invite people. When it was over, he stood and I followed him. Two men remained, absorbed in conversation, and did not leave. He began going to his wives, greeting each one and saying: Peace be upon you. How are you, people of the household? They said: Well, Messenger of Allah. How did you find your wife? He said: Well. When he finished, he returned, and I returned with him. When he reached the door, the two men were still absorbed in conversation. When they saw him return, they stood and left. By Allah, I do not know whether I told him they had left or revelation was sent to him that they had left. He returned, and I returned with him. When he put his foot on the threshold, he lowered the curtain between him and me, and Allah Most High revealed this verse: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you”.
de: Anas said: I attended Zaynab's Hochzeitsmahl. He satisfied the people with bread and meat, and he used to send me to invite people. When it was over, he stood and I followed him. Two men remained, absorbed in conversation, and did not leave. He began going to his wives, greeting each one and saying: Peace be upon you. How are you, people of the household? They said: Well, Messenger of Allah. How did you find your wife? Er sagte: Well. When he finished, he returned, and I returned with him. When he reached the door, the two men were still absorbed in conversation. When they saw him return, they stood and left. By Allah, I do not know whether I told him they had left or revelation was sent to him that they had left. He returned, and I returned with him. When he put his foot on the threshold, he lowered the curtain between him and me, and Allah Most High revealed this verse: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you”. en: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun narrated to us. Bahz narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim narrated to us. They both said: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas. This is Bahz's narration: When Zaynab's waiting period ended, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to Zayd: Mention me to her. Zayd went to her while she was kneading her dough. When I saw her, she became so great in my heart that I could not look at her because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had mentioned her. I turned my back and retreated, saying: Zaynab, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) has sent me to mention you. She said: I will do nothing until I consult my Lord. She went to her prayer place, and the Quran was revealed. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came and entered upon her without permission. He said: I saw that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) fed us bread and meat when the day had grown long. The people left, but some men remained speaking in the house after the meal. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and I followed him. He went around his wives' rooms, greeting them, and they said: Messenger of Allah, how did you find your wife? He said: I do not know whether I told him that the people had left or he told me. He went until he entered the house. I wanted to enter with him, but he lowered the curtain between us, and the verse of the veil was revealed. The people were admonished with what they were admonished. Ibn Rafi added in his narration: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you to a meal, without waiting for it to be ready” through the words “Allah is not ashamed of the truth” (Quran 33:53).
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun überlieferte uns. Bahz überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim überlieferte uns. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and I followed him. He went around his wives' rooms, greeting them, and they said: Messenger of Allah, how did you find your wife? Ibn Rafi added in his narration: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you to a Mahlzeit, without waiting for it to be ready” through the words “Allah is not ashamed of the truth” (Quran 33:53). en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani, Abu Kamil Fudayl ibn Husayn, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. They said: Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas. In Abu Kamil's narration: I heard Anas say: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) hold a wedding feast for any of his wives as he did for Zaynab. He slaughtered a sheep.

en: Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Abbad ibn Jabal ibn Abi Rawwad and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us. They both said: Muhammad, meaning Ibn Jafar, narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb. He said: I heard Anas ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) held no wedding feast for any of his wives greater or better than the feast he held for Zaynab. Thabit al-Bunani said: What did he serve at the feast? He said: He fed them bread and meat until they left it.
de: Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Abbad ibn Jabal ibn Abi Rawwad and Muhammad ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. They both said: Muhammad, meaning Ibn Jafar, überlieferte uns. en: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi, Asim ibn al-Nadr al-Taymi, and Muhammad ibn Abd al-Ala narrated to us, all from Mutamir, and the wording is Ibn Habib's. Mutamir ibn Sulayman narrated to us. He said: I heard my father. Abu Mijlaz narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik. He said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) married Zaynab bint Jahsh, he invited the people. They ate, then sat talking. He took the posture of preparing to stand, but they did not stand. When he saw that, he stood, and those who stood from the people stood. Asim and Ibn Abd al-Ala added: Three men sat while the Prophet (peace be upon him) came to enter and found the people sitting. Then they stood and left. I came and told the Prophet (peace be upon him) that they had left. He came and entered. I wanted to enter, but he lowered the curtain between us. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, without waiting for it to be ready” through the words “Indeed, that is great in the sight of Allah” (Quran 33:53).

en: Amr al-Naqid narrated to me. Yaqub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sad narrated to us. My father narrated to us, from Salih. Ibn Shihab said: Anas ibn Malik said: I know the most about the veil. Ubayy ibn Kab used to ask me about it. Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became a bridegroom with Zaynab bint Jahsh. He had married her in Madinah and invited people to food after the day had risen. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sat, and men sat with him after the people had stood, until the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) stood. He walked, and I walked with him, until he reached the door of Aisha's room. He thought they had left, so he returned, and I returned with him. They were still sitting in their place. He returned, and I returned a second time until he reached Aisha's room. He returned, and I returned, and they had stood. He placed the curtain between us, and Allah revealed the verse of the veil.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Jafar, meaning Ibn Sulayman, narrated to us, from al-Jad Abu Uthman, from Anas ibn Malik. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married and entered upon his wife. My mother, Umm Sulaym, prepared a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a bowl and said: Anas, take this to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and say: My mother sends this to you, greets you, and says: This is little from us for you, Messenger of Allah. I took it to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said that. He said: Put it down. Then he said: Go and invite so-and-so, so-and-so, so-and-so, and everyone you meet, naming men. I invited those he named and those I met. I asked Anas how many they were. He said: About three hundred. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: Anas, bring the bowl. They entered until the platform and room were full. He said: Let ten sit in each circle, and let each person eat from what is in front of him. They ate until satisfied. One group left and another entered until all had eaten. He said: Anas, lift it. I lifted it, and I do not know whether there was more when I put it down or when I lifted it. Groups of them sat talking in the house of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), while he sat and his wife turned her face toward the wall. They became a burden to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), so he went out and greeted his wives, then returned. When they saw him return, they thought they had burdened him, so they hurried to the door and all left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came until he lowered the curtain and entered, while I was sitting in the room. He stayed only a short while, then came out to me. This verse was revealed, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and recited it to the people: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, without waiting for it to be ready; but when you are invited, enter, and when you have eaten, disperse and do not linger for conversation, for that harms the Prophet” (Quran 33:53). al-Jad said: Anas ibn Malik said: I am the most recent of the people to know these verses, and the wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him) were veiled.

My mother, Umm Sulaym, prepared a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a bowl and said: Anas, take this to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and say: My mother sends this to you, greets you, and says: This is little from us for you, Messenger of Allah. I invited those he named and those I met. I asked Anas how many they were. Er sagte: About three hundred. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: Anas, bring the bowl. They entered until the platform and room were full. Er sagte: Let ten sit in each circle, and let each person eat from what is in front of him. They ate until satisfied. One group left and another entered until all had eaten. Er sagte: Anas, lift it. I lifted it, and I do not know whether there was more when I put it down or when I lifted it. Groups of them sat talking in the house of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), while he sat and his wife turned her face toward the wall. They became a burden to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), so he went out and greeted his wives, then returned. When they saw him return, they thought they had burdened him, so they hurried to the door and all left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came until he lowered the curtain and entered, while I was sitting in the room. He stayed only a short while, then came out to me. This verse was revealed, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) went out and recited it to the people: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a Mahlzeit, without waiting for it to be ready; but when you are invited, enter, and when you have eaten, disperse and do not linger for conversation, for that harms the Prophet” (Quran 33:53). al-Jad said: Anas ibn Malik said: I am the most recent of the people to know these verses, and the wives of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) were veiled. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar narrated to us, from Abu Uthman, from Anas. He said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) married Zaynab, Umm Sulaym gave him a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a stone bowl. Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Go and invite every Muslim you meet. I invited everyone I met. They entered, ate, and left. The Prophet (peace be upon him) placed his hand on the food, prayed over it, and said whatever Allah willed him to say. I did not leave anyone I met without inviting him. They ate until satisfied and left, but a group remained and prolonged their conversation. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was too shy to say anything to them, so he went out and left them in the house. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, without waiting for it to be ready” (Quran 33:53). Qatadah said: without waiting for a meal, but when you are invited, enter, until it reached: “That is purer for your hearts and their hearts” (Quran 33:53).
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar überlieferte uns, from Abu Uthman, from Anas. Er sagte: When der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) heiratete Zaynab, Umm Sulaym gave him a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a stone bowl. Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Go and invite every Muslim you meet. I invited everyone I met. They entered, ate, and left. The Prophet (peace be upon him) placed his hand on the food, prayed over it, and said whatever Allah willed him to say. I did not leave anyone I met without inviting him. They ate until satisfied and left, but a group remained and prolonged their conversation. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a Mahlzeit, without waiting for it to be ready” (Quran 33:53). Qatadah said: without waiting for a Mahlzeit, but when you are invited, enter, until it reached: “That is purer for your hearts and their hearts” (Quran 33:53). en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you is invited to a wedding feast, let him attend it.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you is invited to a Hochzeitsmahl, let him attend it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Khalid ibn al-Harith narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: When one of you is invited to a wedding feast, let him accept. Khalid said: Ubayd Allah interpreted it as referring to a wedding.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Khalid ibn al-Harith überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: When one of you is invited to a Hochzeitsmahl, let him accept. Khalid said: Ubayd Allah interpreted it as referring to a Hochzeit. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Numayr narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: When one of you is invited to a wedding feast, let him accept.
de: Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: When one of you is invited to a Hochzeitsmahl, let him accept. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Rabi and Abu Kamil narrated to me. They both said: Hammad narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us. Qutaybah narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Attend the invitation when you are invited.
de: Abu al-Rabi and Abu Kamil überlieferte mir. They both said: Hammad überlieferte uns. Ayyub überlieferte uns. Qutaybah überlieferte uns. Hammad überlieferte uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Attend the invitation when you are invited. en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Nafi. Ibn Umar used to say, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him): When one of you invites his brother, let him accept, whether it is a wedding or something similar.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar überlieferte uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi. Ibn Umar used to say, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm): When one of you invites his brother, let him accept, whether it is a Hochzeit or something similar. en: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me. Isa ibn al-Mundhir narrated to me. Baqiyyah narrated to us. al-Zubaydi narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is invited to a wedding or something similar, let him accept.
de: Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte mir. Isa ibn al-Mundhir überlieferte mir. Baqiyyah überlieferte uns. al-Zubaydi überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is invited to a Hochzeit or something similar, let him accept. en: Humayd ibn Masadah al-Bahili narrated to me. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us. Ismail ibn Umayyah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Attend the invitation when you are invited.
de: Humayd ibn Masadah al-Bahili überlieferte mir. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal überlieferte uns. Ismail ibn Umayyah überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Attend the invitation when you are invited. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harun ibn Abd Allah narrated to me. Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Musa ibn Uqbah informed me, from Nafi. I heard Abd Allah ibn Umar say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Accept this invitation when you are invited to it. Abd Allah ibn Umar used to attend invitations to weddings and other occasions, and he attended them while fasting.
de: Harun ibn Abd Allah überlieferte mir. Hajjaj ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Musa ibn Uqbah berichtete mir, from Nafi. I heard Abd Allah ibn Umar say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Accept this invitation when you are invited to it. Abd Allah ibn Umar used to attend invitations to Hochzeits and other occasions, and he attended them while Fasten. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Umar ibn Muhammad narrated to me, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: When you are invited to a sheep's leg, accept.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Umar ibn Muhammad überlieferte mir, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: When you are invited to a sheep's leg, accept. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. They both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you is invited to a meal, let him accept. If he wishes, he may eat, and if he wishes, he may leave it. Ibn al-Muthanna did not mention the words: to a meal.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. They both said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you is invited to a Mahlzeit, let him accept. If he wishes, he may eat, and if he wishes, he may leave it. Ibn al-Muthanna did not mention the words: to a Mahlzeit. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Numayr narrated to us. Abu Asim narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, with this chain and the same meaning.
de: Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. Abu Asim überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, with this chain and the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Hafs ibn Ghiyath narrated to us, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you is invited, let him accept. If he is fasting, let him pray, and if he is not fasting, let him eat.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Hafs ibn Ghiyath überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra.
